requirements.title: TSCF dropped at a time-sync-incapable server
requirements.text: select_header_variant rejects a TSCF-subtyped AVTPDU with RcpError::TimeSyncUnsupported when the receiving server has no time-synchronization support, without decoding the remainder of the header

requirements.title: TSCF accepted at a time-sync-capable server
requirements.text: select_header_variant decodes a TSCF-subtyped AVTPDU into HeaderVariant::Tscf when the receiving server supports time synchronization, delegating to decode_tscf_header for the header body

requirements.title: NTSCF always accepted regardless of time-sync capability
requirements.text: select_header_variant decodes an NTSCF-subtyped AVTPDU into HeaderVariant::Ntscf regardless of the receiving server's time-synchronization capability

requirements.title: select_header_variant never panics on malformed input
requirements.text: select_header_variant never panics on empty, truncated, or unrecognized-subtype input, returning ShortFrame or Other instead

requirements.title: ByteMessageInfo field model
requirements.text: ByteMessageInfo models the ACF_ABB/ACF_GBB shared header fields (acf_msg_length, pad, mtv, byte_bus_id, evt as an ack flag plus 3-bit sub_opcode, hs, cs, transaction_num, op, rsp, err, ms) plus a documented, non-ambiguous convention for the dual-purpose read_size/segment_num field rather than a single ambiguous field

requirements.title: byte_message_info encode/decode round-trip
requirements.text: encode_byte_message_info followed by decode_byte_message_info recovers the original ByteMessageInfo, including at the 11-bit byte_bus_id/acf_msg_length maxima and the 3-bit evt.sub_opcode maximum

requirements.title: byte_message_info encode rejects out-of-range fields
requirements.text: encode_byte_message_info rejects an acf_msg_length or byte_bus_id wider than 11 bits and an evt.sub_opcode wider than 3 bits

requirements.title: byte_message_info decode never panics
requirements.text: decode_byte_message_info never panics on truncated or arbitrary input, across a swept range of input lengths

requirements.title: AcfAbbMessage field model
requirements.text: AcfAbbMessage models an ACF_ABB message as a ByteMessageInfo plus an opaque payload only, with no timestamp field of any kind and no reserved gap sized for one

requirements.title: ACF_ABB encode/decode round-trip
requirements.text: encode_acf_abb followed by decode_acf_abb recovers the original message, and the encoded length is always exactly the discriminant byte plus byte_message_info plus the payload, with no timestamp region inserted

requirements.title: ACF_ABB acf_msg_type discriminant
requirements.text: Encoded ACF_ABB messages carry the acf_msg_type discriminant 0x0E as their leading byte

requirements.title: ACF_ABB decode rejects malformed input
requirements.text: decode_acf_abb rejects empty/too-short input and input whose leading byte is not the ACF_ABB discriminant 0x0E, distinguishing the ACF_GBB discriminant 0x0D with a specific hint

requirements.title: ACF_ABB decode never panics
requirements.text: decode_acf_abb never panics on arbitrary or truncated input, across a swept range of input lengths

requirements.title: AcfGbbMessage field model
requirements.text: AcfGbbMessage models an ACF_GBB message as a ByteMessageInfo plus a 64-bit message_timestamp plus an opaque payload; message_timestamp is carried/round-tripped as a raw value only, with full rollover/fallback semantics deferred to the Timestamp Semantics checklist item

requirements.title: ACF_GBB encode/decode round-trip
requirements.text: encode_acf_gbb followed by decode_acf_gbb recovers the original message, including the full 64-bit message_timestamp range, and the encoded length is always exactly the discriminant byte plus byte_message_info plus the 8-byte timestamp plus the payload

requirements.title: ACF_GBB acf_msg_type discriminant
requirements.text: Encoded ACF_GBB messages carry the acf_msg_type discriminant 0x0D as their leading byte

requirements.title: ACF_GBB decode rejects malformed input
requirements.text: decode_acf_gbb rejects empty/too-short input and input whose leading byte is not the ACF_GBB discriminant 0x0D, distinguishing the ACF_ABB discriminant 0x0E with a specific hint

requirements.title: ACF_GBB decode never panics
requirements.text: decode_acf_gbb never panics on arbitrary or truncated input, across a swept range of input lengths

requirements.title: StreamId construct/parse model
requirements.text: StreamId decomposes an opaque 64-bit AVTP stream_id into a sender MAC address and a locally-assigned unique-id suffix (and composes the reverse), via build_stream_id/parse_stream_id and the StreamId::to_u64/from_u64/From/Into wrappers around them

requirements.title: stream_id round-trip
requirements.text: build_stream_id composed with parse_stream_id recovers the original sender MAC address and unique-id suffix, including the all-zero and all-0xFF extremes

requirements.title: stream_id bit layout
requirements.text: build_stream_id places the sender MAC address in the upper 48 bits of the composed stream_id (most-significant octet first) and the unique-id suffix in the lower 16 bits

requirements.title: parse_stream_id never panics
requirements.text: parse_stream_id never panics for any u64 input value, across a swept range including the extremes

requirements.title: StreamId interop with NTSCF/TSCF opaque field
requirements.text: A StreamId composed to u64 and carried through NtscfHeader::stream_id or TscfHeader::stream_id's encode/decode round trip parses back to the original StreamId

requirements.title: EndpointTable / EndpointId model
requirements.text: EndpointTable models a (stream_id, byte_bus_id) -> EndpointId lookup as a map keyed first by StreamId and then, per stream, by byte_bus_id, so that byte_bus_id's keyspace is scoped to a single stream rather than shared globally across all streams

requirements.title: EndpointTable::register enforces per-pair uniqueness and field width
requirements.text: EndpointTable::register rejects a byte_bus_id wider than the 11-bit field width shared with ByteMessageInfo::byte_bus_id with RcpError::InvalidSize, and rejects re-registering an already-registered (stream_id, byte_bus_id) pair with RcpError::EndpointAlreadyRegistered without modifying the existing registration, while permitting the same byte_bus_id to be registered independently under a different stream_id

requirements.title: EndpointTable::lookup resolves the stream-relative pair
requirements.text: EndpointTable::lookup resolves a (stream_id, byte_bus_id) pair to the EndpointId registered under that exact pair, returning None when either component does not match a registered entry, and never returning an endpoint registered under a different stream_id even when byte_bus_id matches

requirements.title: EndpointTable::lookup never panics
requirements.text: EndpointTable::lookup never panics for any (stream_id, byte_bus_id) input, on an empty table or a populated one, across a swept range including the all-zero and all-0xFF/u16::MAX extremes

requirements.title: Echo-back rule model
requirements.text: The echo-back rule (a response/ack must carry the same byte_bus_id it was received under) is modeled as a pair of plain functions over already-decoded ByteMessageInfo values, build_response_info and verify_echo_back, with no dependency on StreamId/EndpointTable addressing machinery

requirements.title: build_response_info echoes byte_bus_id and sets rsp
requirements.text: build_response_info returns a response ByteMessageInfo with byte_bus_id copied from the request and rsp forced true, leaving every other field of the caller-supplied response template unchanged

requirements.title: verify_echo_back accepts matching and rejects mismatched byte_bus_id
requirements.text: verify_echo_back returns Ok when response.byte_bus_id equals request.byte_bus_id regardless of the response.rsp flag, and returns Err(RcpError::EchoBackMismatch) when byte_bus_id differs

requirements.title: Echo-back rule functions never panic
requirements.text: build_response_info and verify_echo_back never panic for any combination of ByteMessageInfo field values, across a swept range of byte_bus_id inputs

requirements.title: AvtpTimestamp/MessageTimestamp are distinct types
requirements.text: AvtpTimestamp (wrapping TscfHeader::avtp_timestamp's raw u32) and MessageTimestamp (wrapping AcfGbbMessage::message_timestamp's raw u64) are modeled as two distinct newtypes with no shared trait or cross-type comparison, so the two fields' distinct widths and distinct rollover periods can never be confused with one another

requirements.title: AvtpTimestamp wraparound-aware comparison
requirements.text: AvtpTimestamp::wrapping_delta/is_after compare two 32-bit timestamps correctly across their rollover boundary, reporting a small delta when one value has just wrapped past the other rather than a large one

requirements.title: MessageTimestamp wraparound-aware comparison
requirements.text: MessageTimestamp::wrapping_delta/is_after compare two 64-bit timestamps correctly across their own, independent rollover boundary, using the same wraparound convention as AvtpTimestamp but over a distinct, much longer period

requirements.title: Invalid/uncertain timestamp fallback rule
requirements.text: AvtpTimestamp::semantics/is_untimed and MessageTimestamp::semantics/is_untimed fold an exact all-zero raw value down to TimestampMeaning::Untimed and treat every other raw value, including the widest representable one, as TimestampMeaning::Timed

requirements.title: Round trip / interop with the raw wire fields
requirements.text: AvtpTimestamp/MessageTimestamp round-trip through their raw u32/u64 values (including via From/Into) and interoperate with values sourced from TscfHeader::avtp_timestamp and AcfGbbMessage::message_timestamp without either header/message struct's field type changing

requirements.title: Timestamp semantics never panic
requirements.text: AvtpTimestamp and MessageTimestamp's semantics/is_untimed/wrapping_delta/is_after never panic for any combination of raw input values, across a swept range including the all-zero, all-1s, and half-rollover-period extremes

requirements.title: RcServerState three-state model and numeric encoding
requirements.text: RcServerState models the three named RC Server lifecycle states (HwUnconfigured, HwConfigured, RcpConfigured) with wire-level byte encodings 0x00/0x55/0xAA respectively, defaults to HwUnconfigured, and round-trips every valid encoding through to_u8/from_u8

requirements.title: RcServerState::from_u8 rejects unrecognized bytes
requirements.text: RcServerState::from_u8 returns Err(RcpError::Other) for every byte other than 0x00, 0x55, and 0xAA, without panicking

requirements.title: Per-state register category reachability rule
requirements.text: is_register_reachable models RegisterCategory::General and RegisterCategory::HwConfig as reachable in every RcServerState, and RegisterCategory::RcpConfig as reachable only in HwConfigured and RcpConfigured, not in HwUnconfigured

requirements.title: check_register_reachable enforces the reachability rule
requirements.text: check_register_reachable returns Ok(()) exactly when is_register_reachable would return true for the same (state, category) pair, and Err(RcpError::UnauthorizedAccess) otherwise

requirements.title: Lifecycle decode and reachability checks never panic
requirements.text: RcServerState::from_u8 never panics across the full 0..=255 byte range, and is_register_reachable/check_register_reachable never panic for any RcServerState/RegisterCategory pair

requirements.title: Transition guard defines exactly the three implemented transitions
requirements.text: is_transition_defined returns true only for (HwUnconfigured, HwConfigured), (HwConfigured, RcpConfigured), and (HwConfigured, HwUnconfigured), and false for every other RcServerState pair; RcServerState::try_transition succeeds on exactly those same three pairs (subject to the consistency guard for the first two, unconditionally for the third)

requirements.title: try_transition enforces the caller-supplied consistency guard
requirements.text: RcServerState::try_transition returns Ok(target) when the is_consistent closure returns true for one of the two defined transitions, and returns Err(RcpError::InvalidParameter) (for either guard) when is_consistent returns false

requirements.title: try_transition rejects undefined transitions without invoking the guard, and never panics
requirements.text: RcServerState::try_transition returns Err(RcpError::RequestRejected) without calling is_consistent for every (from, to) pair other than the three implemented transitions (including identity, any move originating at RcpConfigured, and skipping HwConfigured entirely), and never panics for any (from, to) pair or guard result

requirements.title: LockPolicy per-category (W vs W*) assignment
requirements.text: lock_policy maps RegisterCategory::General to None (never writable), RegisterCategory::HwConfig to Some(LockPolicy::WStar), and RegisterCategory::RcpConfig to Some(LockPolicy::W); is_register_writable composes that mapping with is_register_reachable so General is never writable, HwConfig is writable while reachable except in RcpConfigured, and RcpConfig is writable whenever reachable including in RcpConfigured

requirements.title: check_register_writable enforces the write-lock rule and distinguishes unreachable from locked
requirements.text: check_register_writable returns Ok(()) exactly when is_register_writable would return true for the same (state, category) pair, Err(RcpError::UnauthorizedAccess) if the category is not reachable at all in that state, and Err(RcpError::LockedMemAccess) if it is reachable but write-locked

requirements.title: Write-lock checks never panic
requirements.text: lock_policy, is_register_writable, and check_register_writable never panic for any RcServerState/RegisterCategory pair

requirements.title: Demotion path HwConfigured -> HwUnconfigured is unconditional and single-hop only
requirements.text: RcServerState::try_transition(HwConfigured, HwUnconfigured, is_consistent) always returns Ok(HwUnconfigured) regardless of what is_consistent would return, and never invokes is_consistent for this pair; is_transition_defined(HwConfigured, HwUnconfigured) returns true; demotion originating at RcpConfigured (to either HwConfigured or HwUnconfigured) remains outside this transition's scope and continues to return Err(RcpError::RequestRejected)

requirements.title: EP0 reserved byte_bus_id recognition
requirements.text: EP0_BYTE_BUS_ID is 0, and is_ep0_address returns true iff byte_bus_id equals EP0_BYTE_BUS_ID, for every representable byte_bus_id value, without panicking

requirements.title: EP0 vs. device-endpoint routing is decided before and independent of EndpointTable
requirements.text: route_byte_bus_id returns RequestRoute::Ep0 iff byte_bus_id is EP0_BYTE_BUS_ID and RequestRoute::DeviceEndpoint otherwise, for every representable byte_bus_id value, without panicking and without taking or consulting an EndpointTable; the routing decision for EP0_BYTE_BUS_ID is unchanged regardless of whether EndpointTable has an entry registered at that byte_bus_id

requirements.title: EP0 access direction derived from ByteMessageInfo::op
requirements.text: access_kind returns Ep0AccessKind::Read when info.op is false and Ep0AccessKind::Write when info.op is true

requirements.title: EP0 read access composes with lifecycle register reachability
requirements.text: check_ep0_access with an info whose op is false returns the same result as lifecycle::check_register_reachable for the same (state, category) pair, for every RcServerState/RegisterCategory combination

requirements.title: EP0 write access composes with lifecycle register writability and distinguishes unreachable from locked
requirements.text: check_ep0_access with an info whose op is true returns the same result as lifecycle::check_register_writable for the same (state, category) pair, for every RcServerState/RegisterCategory combination, including reporting RcpError::UnauthorizedAccess (not LockedMemAccess) for an unreachable category and RcpError::LockedMemAccess for a reachable but write-locked category

requirements.title: EP0 access check never panics
requirements.text: check_ep0_access never panics for any RcServerState/RegisterCategory/op combination

requirements.title: Root-client identity check
requirements.text: is_root_client(root_client, stream) returns true iff root_client is Some(stream), and false when root_client is None or Some of a different stream

requirements.title: Root-client-aware EP0 reads are unaffected by root-client status
requirements.text: check_ep0_access_for_stream with an info whose op is false returns the same result as check_ep0_access for the same (state, category) pair, regardless of whether requesting_stream is the designated root_client, is a different stream, or root_client is None

requirements.title: Root-client EP0 writes compose with the existing lifecycle-gated write check
requirements.text: check_ep0_access_for_stream with an info whose op is true, where requesting_stream equals root_client, returns the same result as check_ep0_access for the same (state, category) pair, for every RcServerState/RegisterCategory combination

requirements.title: Non-root EP0 writes are rejected with UnauthorizedAccess
requirements.text: check_ep0_access_for_stream with an info whose op is true returns Err(RcpError::UnauthorizedAccess) whenever requesting_stream does not equal root_client (including when root_client is None), for every RcServerState/RegisterCategory combination, without bypassing lifecycle-state gating when requesting_stream does equal root_client

requirements.title: Root-client-aware EP0 access check never panics
requirements.text: check_ep0_access_for_stream never panics for any RcServerState/RegisterCategory/op/requesting_stream/root_client combination

requirements.title: EndpointType numeric encoding and reserved-type flag
requirements.text: EndpointType enumerates the thirteen ep_type codes 0x01-0x0D named in ROADMAP.md Milestones 4 and 7, to_u8/from_u8 round-trip every defined code with no two codes colliding, and is_reserved returns true only for EndpointType::Dac

requirements.title: EndpointType::from_u8 rejects unrecognized bytes
requirements.text: EndpointType::from_u8 returns Err(RcpError::Other) for every byte outside 0x01..=0x0D, without panicking

requirements.title: Three-layer taxonomy structural tagging
requirements.text: PerEpConfigBlock always belongs to ConfigLayer::Generic, CommonFunctionalConfig always belongs to ConfigLayer::CommonFunctional, and PerEpTypeFunctionalConfig::layer() reports ConfigLayer::PerTypeFunctional tagged with its own EndpointType, for every defined EndpointType

requirements.title: Cross-layer ep_type match invariant
requirements.text: functional_config_matches_ep_type returns true iff a PerEpConfigBlock and a PerEpTypeFunctionalConfig carry the same EndpointType, and check_functional_config_matches_ep_type returns Ok(()) in exactly that case and Err(RcpError::InvalidParameter) otherwise, for every EndpointType pair

requirements.title: Provisional ConfigLayer to RegisterCategory mapping
requirements.text: register_category maps ConfigLayer::Generic to RegisterCategory::HwConfig, and both ConfigLayer::CommonFunctional and every ConfigLayer::PerTypeFunctional(EndpointType) variant to RegisterCategory::RcpConfig, agreeing with each other across every defined EndpointType

requirements.title: Register map taxonomy operations never panic
requirements.text: EndpointType::from_u8 never panics across the full 0..=255 byte range, and functional_config_matches_ep_type/check_functional_config_matches_ep_type/layer()/register_category never panic for any EndpointType pair

requirements.title: TableDescriptor encode/decode round-trip and short-input rejection
requirements.text: TableDescriptor::encode/decode round-trip every ptr/capacity pair exactly, decode ignores any trailing bytes beyond ENCODED_LEN, and decode returns Err(RcpError::ShortFrame) for every input shorter than ENCODED_LEN

requirements.title: GeneralRegisters models the full §3.6 general register-map field set
requirements.text: GeneralRegisters carries the six ROADMAP.md-quoted fields (svr_oa_tc18_magic_nr, svr_version, svr_vendor_id, svr_device_id, svr_ep_count, svr_implemented_options) plus the remaining rows of this crate's own §3.6 table extraction, each independently settable/readable, defaults to an all-zero value, and reports CATEGORY == lifecycle::RegisterCategory::General

requirements.title: GeneralRegisters encode/decode round-trip
requirements.text: GeneralRegisters::encode/decode round-trip every field exactly (including all-default and all-max-value instances) via a fixed-length big-endian wire form, and decode ignores any trailing bytes beyond ENCODED_LEN

requirements.title: GeneralRegisters::decode rejects short input
requirements.text: GeneralRegisters::decode returns Err(RcpError::ShortFrame) for every input strictly shorter than ENCODED_LEN, and succeeds for input of exactly ENCODED_LEN

requirements.title: GeneralRegisters/TableDescriptor encode/decode never panic
requirements.text: TableDescriptor::decode and GeneralRegisters::decode never panic for arbitrary byte slices of any length, and GeneralRegisters::encode/TableDescriptor::encode never panic for any field value

requirements.title: HwPinMappingEntry models the §3.7 per-pin mapping row
requirements.text: HwPinMappingEntry carries hw_ep_nr, hw_ep_pin_nr, and an undecomposed hw_pin_props byte, and reports CATEGORY == lifecycle::RegisterCategory::HwConfig

requirements.title: HwPinMappingEntry encode/decode round-trip
requirements.text: HwPinMappingEntry::encode/decode round-trip every field exactly via a fixed-length big-endian wire form, and decode ignores any trailing bytes beyond ENCODED_LEN

requirements.title: HwPinMappingEntry decode rejects short input and never panics
requirements.text: HwPinMappingEntry::decode returns Err(RcpError::ShortFrame) for every input shorter than ENCODED_LEN and never panics for any input length

requirements.title: RequestStreamConfigEntry models the §3.8 per-stream config row
requirements.text: RequestStreamConfigEntry carries rx_stream_id and the remaining fifteen per-stream fields this crate's own §3.8 extraction names, and reports CATEGORY == lifecycle::RegisterCategory::RcpConfig

requirements.title: RequestStreamConfigEntry encode/decode round-trip
requirements.text: RequestStreamConfigEntry::encode/decode round-trip every field exactly (including all-default and all-max-value instances) via a fixed-length big-endian wire form, and decode ignores any trailing bytes beyond ENCODED_LEN

requirements.title: RequestStreamConfigEntry decode rejects short input and never panics
requirements.text: RequestStreamConfigEntry::decode returns Err(RcpError::ShortFrame) for every input shorter than ENCODED_LEN and never panics for any input length

requirements.title: EpByteBusIdMapEntry models the §3.9 stream/byte_bus_id-to-endpoint row and its end-of-table sentinel
requirements.text: EpByteBusIdMapEntry carries map_stream_index, map_byte_bus_id, and map_ep_nr, reports CATEGORY == lifecycle::RegisterCategory::RcpConfig, and is_end_of_table returns true iff map_stream_index == END_OF_TABLE_STREAM_INDEX (0); this module defines no ascending-order validation or enforcement over a table's rows

requirements.title: EpByteBusIdMapEntry encode/decode round-trip
requirements.text: EpByteBusIdMapEntry::encode/decode round-trip every field exactly via a fixed-length big-endian wire form, and decode ignores any trailing bytes beyond ENCODED_LEN

requirements.title: EpByteBusIdMapEntry decode rejects short input and never panics
requirements.text: EpByteBusIdMapEntry::decode returns Err(RcpError::ShortFrame) for every input shorter than ENCODED_LEN and never panics for any input length

requirements.title: ResponseStreamConfigEntry models the §3.10 response/ack queue config row
requirements.text: ResponseStreamConfigEntry carries resp_stream_uid, resp_max_avtpdu_size, resp_queue_size, resp_flush_on_count, and resp_flush_time, and reports CATEGORY == lifecycle::RegisterCategory::RcpConfig

requirements.title: ResponseStreamConfigEntry encode/decode round-trip
requirements.text: ResponseStreamConfigEntry::encode/decode round-trip every field exactly via a fixed-length big-endian wire form, and decode ignores any trailing bytes beyond ENCODED_LEN

requirements.title: ResponseStreamConfigEntry decode rejects short input and never panics
requirements.text: ResponseStreamConfigEntry::decode returns Err(RcpError::ShortFrame) for every input shorter than ENCODED_LEN and never panics for any input length

requirements.title: SequencerStateEntry models the §3.11 per-sequencer state register and its power-on default
requirements.text: SequencerStateEntry carries seq_state, reports CATEGORY == lifecycle::RegisterCategory::RcpConfig, and power_on_default() returns seq_state == 1

requirements.title: SequencerStateEntry encode/decode round-trip
requirements.text: SequencerStateEntry::encode/decode round-trip every field exactly via a fixed-length wire form, and decode ignores any trailing bytes beyond ENCODED_LEN

requirements.title: SequencerStateEntry decode rejects short input and never panics
requirements.text: SequencerStateEntry::decode returns Err(RcpError::ShortFrame) for every input shorter than ENCODED_LEN and never panics for any input length

requirements.title: Generic config-table row encode_rows/decode_rows round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: encode_rows/decode_rows round-trip an arbitrary-length row slice for each of HwPinMappingEntry, RequestStreamConfigEntry, EpByteBusIdMapEntry, ResponseStreamConfigEntry, and SequencerStateEntry, decode_rows returns Err(RcpError::ShortFrame) when the input length is not an exact multiple of the row's ROW_LEN, and never panics for any input length

requirements.title: Discovery broadcast stream_id sentinel recognition
requirements.text: is_discovery_broadcast_stream_id returns true iff stream_id equals DISCOVERY_BROADCAST_STREAM_ID (sender_mac DISCOVERY_BROADCAST_SENDER_MAC paired with unique_id DISCOVERY_BROADCAST_UNIQUE_ID), and false for any other StreamId value including ones matching only the sender_mac or only the unique_id, without panicking

requirements.title: Discovery request construction and recognition
requirements.text: build_discovery_request produces an AcfAbbMessage addressed to EP0_BYTE_BUS_ID with op false (read direction) and a payload whose leading DISCOVERY_REGISTER_ADDRESS_LEN bytes big-endian-decode to DISCOVERY_REGISTER_ADDRESS (0), such that is_discovery_request(&result) is true, and the message round-trips through encode_acf_abb/decode_acf_abb unchanged with is_discovery_request still true afterward

requirements.title: Discovery request recognition rejects non-matching shapes
requirements.text: is_discovery_request returns false when byte_bus_id is not EP0_BYTE_BUS_ID, when op is true (write direction), when the payload's leading DISCOVERY_REGISTER_ADDRESS_LEN bytes decode to a register address other than 0, or when the payload is shorter than DISCOVERY_REGISTER_ADDRESS_LEN, and ignores any payload bytes beyond the register-address prefix

requirements.title: Discovery response answerable in any lifecycle state
requirements.text: build_discovery_response succeeds for every RcServerState variant (HwUnconfigured, HwConfigured, RcpConfigured) by composing with lifecycle::check_register_reachable(state, RegisterCategory::General), producing a response whose byte_message_info echoes the request's byte_bus_id per the existing echo-back rule and whose payload equals general.encode() verbatim, round-tripping through encode_acf_abb/decode_acf_abb with GeneralRegisters::decode recovering the original content

requirements.title: Discovery request/response helpers never panic
requirements.text: is_discovery_request never panics for any byte_bus_id/op/payload-length combination, build_discovery_response never panics for any RcServerState, and is_discovery_broadcast_stream_id never panics for any sampled sender_mac/unique_id combination

requirements.title: Discovery claim lapse boundary semantics
requirements.text: DiscoveryClaim::has_lapsed returns false while elapsed time since claimed_at is strictly less than timeout, true once elapsed time reaches or exceeds timeout (inclusive boundary), and uses saturating_duration_since so that a now earlier than claimed_at reads as zero elapsed time rather than panicking or wrapping

requirements.title: Discovery-stream first-claimant rule and Discovery_TimeOut lapse-and-reopen
requirements.text: try_claim_discovery_stream grants a claim timestamped now when current is None, grants and re-timestamps a claim when current already belongs to the same claimant (refresh), and grants a new claim to any claimant once the existing claim's has_lapsed is true as of now under timeout (Discovery_TimeOut lapse-and-reopen), with DISCOVERY_TIME_OUT defaulting to 20ms

requirements.title: Discovery-stream claim rejects a second live claimant
requirements.text: try_claim_discovery_stream returns Err(RcpError::RequestRejected) when current holds a live (not lapsed) claim for a claimant different from the requested claimant, leaving the caller's own copy of the existing claim unaffected by the rejected attempt

requirements.title: Discovery-stream claim rejects the broadcast sentinel as claimant
requirements.text: try_claim_discovery_stream returns Err(RcpError::InvalidParameter) whenever the requested claimant equals DISCOVERY_BROADCAST_STREAM_ID, regardless of whether current is None, holds a live claim, or holds a lapsed claim

requirements.title: Discovery-stream claiming helpers never panic
requirements.text: try_claim_discovery_stream never panics for any sampled combination of current claim state, claimant (including the broadcast sentinel), now, and timeout

requirements.title: Discovery read access always succeeds regardless of claim state
requirements.text: check_discovery_access with DiscoveryAccessKind::Read succeeds unconditionally for any requester (claimant, non-claimant, or the broadcast sentinel), never consulting the current claim, now, or timeout parameters

requirements.title: Discovery configure access permitted for unclaimed, own-claim, and lapsed-claim cases
requirements.text: check_discovery_access with DiscoveryAccessKind::Configure succeeds when current is None (unclaimed), when current already belongs to the requester (live-claimant self-configure), or when current's claim has DiscoveryClaim::has_lapsed as of now under timeout, agreeing in every case with the grant decision try_claim_discovery_stream itself would reach for the same inputs

requirements.title: Discovery configure access rejects a different live claimant
requirements.text: check_discovery_access with DiscoveryAccessKind::Configure returns Err(RcpError::UnauthorizedAccess) when current holds a live (not lapsed) claim for a requester different from the one asking to configure

requirements.title: Discovery configure access rejects the broadcast sentinel as requester
requirements.text: check_discovery_access with DiscoveryAccessKind::Configure returns Err(RcpError::InvalidParameter) whenever requester equals DISCOVERY_BROADCAST_STREAM_ID, regardless of whether current is None, holds a live claim, or holds a lapsed claim

requirements.title: Discovery access-kind check never panics
requirements.text: check_discovery_access never panics for any sampled combination of current claim state, requester (including the broadcast sentinel), DiscoveryAccessKind, now, and timeout

requirements.title: Discovery cache remember/lookup round-trips the cache-worthy identity subset
requirements.text: DiscoveryCache::remember records a DiscoveryCacheEntry for stream_id keyed off the cache-worthy subset of a supplied GeneralRegisters (svr_oa_tc18_magic_nr, svr_version, svr_vendor_id, svr_device_id, svr_ep_count) and the supplied now; DiscoveryCache::lookup/is_known retrieve it, and remembering again under the same stream_id overwrites rather than duplicates the entry

requirements.title: Discovery cache remember rejects the broadcast sentinel as a cache key
requirements.text: DiscoveryCache::remember returns Err(RcpError::InvalidParameter), without modifying the cache, whenever stream_id equals DISCOVERY_BROADCAST_STREAM_ID

requirements.title: Discovery cache staleness check has an inclusive boundary and never panics on out-of-order now
requirements.text: DiscoveryCacheEntry::is_stale (and DiscoveryCache::is_known, which composes it) reports stale once at least max_age has elapsed since the entry's cached_at, inclusive at the exact boundary, and uses Instant::saturating_duration_since so an out-of-order now never panics or wraps

requirements.title: Discovery cache invalidate removes an entry and matches detects an identity change
requirements.text: DiscoveryCache::invalidate removes stream_id's cached entry if present (returning true) and is a no-op returning false if absent; DiscoveryCacheEntry::matches returns false when a freshly observed GeneralRegisters' cache-worthy subset differs from the entry's own, distinguishing a still-valid cache entry from a changed server identity at the same stream_id

requirements.title: Discovery cache operations never panic
requirements.text: DiscoveryCache::remember/lookup/is_known/invalidate and DiscoveryCacheEntry::is_stale/matches never panic for any sampled combination of stream_id (including the broadcast sentinel), GeneralRegisters content, now, and max_age

requirements.title: GpioBitmask round-trips through encode/decode as a 4-byte big-endian bitmask
requirements.text: GpioBitmask::encode/GpioBitmask::decode round-trip any u32 value through the GPIO endpoint's 4-byte read/write bitmask shape, encoded big-endian, matching the byte order convention every other Milestone 1-3 wire type already uses

requirements.title: GpioBitmask decode never panics on short or truncated input
requirements.text: GpioBitmask::decode returns Err(RcpError::ShortFrame) for any input shorter than GPIO_BITMASK_LEN instead of panicking, and ignores any trailing bytes beyond the first four

requirements.title: GpioWriteSemantics round-trips through evt.sub_opcode for all eight values
requirements.text: GpioWriteSemantics::to_sub_opcode/GpioWriteSemantics::from_sub_opcode round-trip every one of the eight write-semantics variants across the full 0..=7 range of the 3-bit evt.sub_opcode field, with no value left unmapped

requirements.title: GpioWriteSemantics::from_sub_opcode rejects values outside the 3-bit sub_opcode range
requirements.text: GpioWriteSemantics::from_sub_opcode returns Err(RcpError::InvalidParameter) for any raw byte greater than EVT_SUB_OPCODE_MAX (0x07), never panicking

requirements.title: apply_gpio_write implements Replace/Or/And/Xor as their named bitwise operations
requirements.text: apply_gpio_write computes Replace as the operand overwriting current, and Or/And/Xor as the corresponding bitwise combination of current and operand

requirements.title: apply_gpio_write's Add semantics wraps rather than panics on u32 overflow
requirements.text: apply_gpio_write computes GpioWriteSemantics::Add as current.wrapping_add(operand), so a current/operand pair that would overflow u32 wraps around to a defined value instead of panicking

requirements.title: apply_gpio_write's SubtractSaturating semantics clamps at zero at the underflow boundary
requirements.text: apply_gpio_write computes GpioWriteSemantics::SubtractSaturating as current.saturating_sub(operand), clamping to zero (inclusive at the exact-equal boundary) rather than wrapping/underflowing when operand exceeds current

requirements.title: apply_gpio_write's Reconfigure semantics matches Replace at the bitmask-value level
requirements.text: apply_gpio_write computes GpioWriteSemantics::Reconfigure identically to GpioWriteSemantics::Replace (the operand becomes the new bitmask value), per this module's flagged working interpretation of the roadmap-named but underspecified reconfigure semantics

requirements.title: The unnamed eighth write semantics is refused rather than guessed
requirements.text: GpioWriteSemantics::is_named is true for every variant except Unnamed8th, and apply_gpio_write returns Err(RcpError::UnsupportedCmd) for GpioWriteSemantics::Unnamed8th rather than inventing a behavior for the roadmap's uncounted eighth write semantics

requirements.title: apply_gpio_write never panics for any sampled semantics/current/operand combination
requirements.text: apply_gpio_write never panics across every GpioWriteSemantics variant combined with a representative sweep of u32 current/operand values including 0, 1, and the u32 boundary values

requirements.title: GpioTriggerConfig round-trips through encode/decode with change/rising/falling field order
requirements.text: GpioTriggerConfig::encode/GpioTriggerConfig::decode round-trip the three per-pin enable masks (change_enable, rising_enable, falling_enable) through a fixed 12-byte big-endian layout in that field order

requirements.title: GpioTriggerConfig decode never panics on short or truncated input
requirements.text: GpioTriggerConfig::decode returns Err(RcpError::ShortFrame) for any input shorter than GPIO_TRIGGER_CONFIG_LEN instead of panicking

requirements.title: evaluate_gpio_triggers detects rising/falling/change edges between a before/after bitmask pair
requirements.text: evaluate_gpio_triggers reports a pin as risen when it transitions 0->1 with rising_enable armed, fallen when it transitions 1->0 with falling_enable armed, and changed when it differs at all with change_enable armed, with no signal reported when the value is unchanged

requirements.title: evaluate_gpio_triggers masks out disarmed pins independently per trigger kind
requirements.text: evaluate_gpio_triggers suppresses a pin's changed/rising/falling signal when that pin's corresponding enable bit is clear in GpioTriggerConfig, and each of the three trigger kinds is evaluated independently per pin so one kind's arming does not affect another's

requirements.title: evaluate_gpio_triggers never panics for any sampled before/after bitmask pair
requirements.text: evaluate_gpio_triggers never panics across a representative sweep of previous/current u32 bitmask value pairs, including all-zero, all-one, and alternating-bit patterns, under a fixed non-trivial GpioTriggerConfig

requirements.title: GpioFunctionalConfig's layer tag matches crate::regmap's EndpointType::Gpio cross-layer rule
requirements.text: GpioFunctionalConfig::layer_tag returns a crate::regmap::PerEpTypeFunctionalConfig tagged EndpointType::Gpio that crate::regmap::functional_config_matches_ep_type/check_functional_config_matches_ep_type accept against a PerEpConfigBlock tagged EndpointType::Gpio, and reject against any other EndpointType, composing with the existing Milestone 2 cross-layer rule without crate::regmap needing to model GPIO's own content

requirements.title: SpiChannelSelect round-trips through evt.sub_opcode for all eight values
requirements.text: SpiChannelSelect::to_sub_opcode/SpiChannelSelect::from_sub_opcode round-trip every value of the 3-bit evt.sub_opcode field (0..=7), covering both the six named channel selections and the two explicit spare variants

requirements.title: SpiChannelSelect::from_sub_opcode rejects values outside the 3-bit sub_opcode range
requirements.text: SpiChannelSelect::from_sub_opcode returns Err(RcpError::InvalidParameter) rather than panicking for any raw byte greater than EVT_SUB_OPCODE_MAX

requirements.title: SpiChannelSelect::is_named is true only for the six named channel selections
requirements.text: SpiChannelSelect::is_named returns true for Channel0..Channel5 and false for the two spare evt.sub_opcode values (Spare6/Spare7) that SPI's up-to-6 channel selection does not use

requirements.title: resolve_spi_channel_index maps named channels to 0..=5 and refuses the two spare values
requirements.text: resolve_spi_channel_index maps SpiChannelSelect::Channel0..Channel5 to indices 0..=5 and returns Err(RcpError::UnsupportedCmd) rather than guessing an index for the two spare sub_opcode values

requirements.title: SpiFunctionalConfig holds exactly SPI_CHANNEL_COUNT (6) pre-configured channel slots
requirements.text: SpiFunctionalConfig::channels has exactly SPI_CHANNEL_COUNT (6) SpiChannelConfigSlot entries, matching the roadmap's up-to-6 pre-configured channel config wording

requirements.title: select_spi_channel_config resolves named channel selections and refuses spare selections
requirements.text: select_spi_channel_config returns Ok with the addressed SpiChannelConfigSlot for each of the six named SpiChannelSelect variants and Err(RcpError::UnsupportedCmd) for the two spare variants, via resolve_spi_channel_index

requirements.title: SpiFunctionalConfig's layer tag matches crate::regmap's EndpointType::Spi cross-layer rule
requirements.text: SpiFunctionalConfig::layer_tag produces a crate::regmap::PerEpTypeFunctionalConfig tagged EndpointType::Spi that satisfies crate::regmap::check_functional_config_matches_ep_type against a generic PerEpConfigBlock of the same ep_type, and is rejected by functional_config_matches_ep_type against a mismatched ep_type

requirements.title: SpiByteTransfer (PICO) round-trips raw bytes through encode/decode and never panics
requirements.text: SpiByteTransfer::encode/SpiByteTransfer::decode round-trip any byte sequence, including an empty one, as the raw PICO (controller-to-peripheral) byte stream without interpreting its contents, and decode never panics for any input length

requirements.title: SpiByteTransferResult (POCI) round-trips raw bytes through encode/decode and never panics
requirements.text: SpiByteTransferResult::encode/SpiByteTransferResult::decode round-trip any byte sequence, including an empty one, as the raw POCI (peripheral-to-controller) byte stream without interpreting its contents, and decode never panics for any input length

requirements.title: SpiStatus round-trips through encode/decode as a fixed 20-byte status and never panics on short input
requirements.text: SpiStatus::encode/SpiStatus::decode round-trip the SPI endpoint's full 20-byte status; decode returns Err(RcpError::ShortFrame) rather than panicking for input shorter than SPI_STATUS_LEN and ignores trailing bytes beyond the first 20

requirements.title: SpiCompoundWaitStatus round-trips through encode/decode as a fixed 4-byte status and never panics on short input
requirements.text: SpiCompoundWaitStatus::encode/SpiCompoundWaitStatus::decode round-trip the compound-wait-truncated 4-byte SPI status shape; decode returns Err(RcpError::ShortFrame) rather than panicking for input shorter than SPI_COMPOUND_WAIT_STATUS_LEN

requirements.title: truncate_spi_status_for_compound_wait extracts exactly the leading 4 of 20 status bytes
requirements.text: truncate_spi_status_for_compound_wait produces an SpiCompoundWaitStatus equal to the leading four bytes of the source SpiStatus's 20-byte form, implementing the roadmap's 4-of-20-byte status truncation rule as standalone plumbing not wired into any compound-wait dispatch; never panics for any input

requirements.title: I2cSpeedMode round-trips through to_u8/from_u8 for all five values
requirements.text: I2cSpeedMode::to_u8/I2cSpeedMode::from_u8 round-trip every one of the five i2c_mode speed presets (Standard, Fast, FastPlus, HighSpeedRowA, HighSpeedRowB), covering the full 0..=4 wire-value range this crate assigns them

requirements.title: I2cSpeedMode::from_u8 rejects values outside the 0..=4 i2c_mode range
requirements.text: I2cSpeedMode::from_u8 returns Err(RcpError::InvalidParameter) rather than panicking for any raw byte greater than 4

requirements.title: I2cSpeedMode::is_ambiguous_high_speed_row flags exactly the two unresolved high-speed rows
requirements.text: I2cSpeedMode::is_ambiguous_high_speed_row returns true only for HighSpeedRowA/HighSpeedRowB, the two adjacent high-speed i2c_mode rows this crate's spec-extraction pass flags as unresolved pending errata rather than silently assigning either a specific named speed, and false for the three unambiguous presets (Standard/Fast/FastPlus); I2cSpeedMode::default() resolves to Standard, which is not an ambiguous row

requirements.title: I2cFunctionalConfig's layer tag matches crate::regmap's EndpointType::I2c cross-layer rule
requirements.text: I2cFunctionalConfig::layer_tag produces a crate::regmap::PerEpTypeFunctionalConfig tagged EndpointType::I2c that satisfies crate::regmap::check_functional_config_matches_ep_type against a generic PerEpConfigBlock of the same ep_type, and is rejected by functional_config_matches_ep_type against a mismatched ep_type; I2cFunctionalConfig::default uses I2cSpeedMode::default

requirements.title: I2cByteTransfer round-trips raw bytes, including address bytes, through encode/decode and never panics
requirements.text: I2cByteTransfer::encode/I2cByteTransfer::decode round-trip any byte sequence, including an empty one, as the raw controller-to-bus byte stream (address byte(s) included, unparsed) without interpreting its contents, and decode never panics for any input length

requirements.title: I2cByteTransferResult round-trips raw bytes through encode/decode and never panics
requirements.text: I2cByteTransferResult::encode/I2cByteTransferResult::decode round-trip any byte sequence, including an empty one, as the raw bus-to-controller byte stream without interpreting its contents, and decode never panics for any input length

requirements.title: UartTxQueue round-trips arbitrary bytes through encode/decode and never panics
requirements.text: UartTxQueue::encode/UartTxQueue::decode round-trip any byte sequence, including an empty one, as the raw TX-queue byte stream without interpreting its contents, and decode never panics for any input length

requirements.title: UartRxQueue round-trips arbitrary bytes through encode/decode and never panics
requirements.text: UartRxQueue::encode/UartRxQueue::decode round-trip any byte sequence, including an empty one, as the raw RX-queue byte stream without interpreting its contents, and decode never panics for any input length

requirements.title: UartTxQueueConfig and UartRxQueueConfig default independently within UartFunctionalConfig
requirements.text: UartFunctionalConfig::default carries a default UartTxQueueConfig and a default UartRxQueueConfig, with UartRxQueueConfig's read_size/uart_timeout fields each defaulting to zero, modeling the TX and RX queues' config content as independent even though it is carried in one shared block

requirements.title: UartFunctionalConfig's layer tag matches crate::regmap's EndpointType::Uart cross-layer rule
requirements.text: UartFunctionalConfig::layer_tag produces a crate::regmap::PerEpTypeFunctionalConfig tagged EndpointType::Uart that satisfies crate::regmap::check_functional_config_matches_ep_type against a generic PerEpConfigBlock of the same ep_type, and is rejected by functional_config_matches_ep_type against a mismatched ep_type

requirements.title: resolve_uart_read_completion reports ReadSizeReached when only the read_size threshold is met
requirements.text: resolve_uart_read_completion returns Some(UartReadCompletionReason::ReadSizeReached) when bytes_collected has reached read_size but elapsed has not yet reached uart_timeout

requirements.title: resolve_uart_read_completion reports TimedOut when only the uart_timeout threshold is met
requirements.text: resolve_uart_read_completion returns Some(UartReadCompletionReason::TimedOut) when elapsed has reached uart_timeout but bytes_collected has not yet reached read_size

requirements.title: resolve_uart_read_completion reports Both, rather than silently preferring one condition, when read_size and uart_timeout are met simultaneously
requirements.text: resolve_uart_read_completion returns Some(UartReadCompletionReason::Both), including for a zeroed UartRxQueueConfig's default thresholds, when both bytes_collected has reached read_size and elapsed has reached uart_timeout at the same evaluation, rather than this crate silently picking ReadSizeReached or TimedOut as the winner of the race the roadmap does not itself resolve

requirements.title: resolve_uart_read_completion returns None before either threshold is met, and never panics
requirements.text: resolve_uart_read_completion returns None when neither bytes_collected has reached read_size nor elapsed has reached uart_timeout, and never panics for any sampled combination of UartRxQueueConfig, bytes_collected, and elapsed values, including boundary values

requirements.title: validate_uart_read_request accepts a payload-less UART read request
requirements.text: validate_uart_read_request returns Ok(()) when the supplied read-request payload is empty, per the payload-less-read-only rule

requirements.title: validate_uart_read_request rejects any non-empty payload on a UART read request with RcpError::UnsupportedCmd, and never panics
requirements.text: validate_uart_read_request returns Err(RcpError::UnsupportedCmd) for any non-empty read-request payload, reflecting this crate's reading of the roadmap's UNKNOWN_CMD wording onto the already-defined UnsupportedCmd/UNSUPPORTED_CMD variant, and never panics for any sampled input length

requirements.title: AdcResolutionBits round-trips through new/to_u8 for the full 1..=16 bit-width range
requirements.text: AdcResolutionBits::new/AdcResolutionBits::to_u8 round-trip every bit-width value from 1 to 16, modeling the roadmap's <=16-bit resolution upper bound as an explicit validated range rather than a fixed 16-bit width

requirements.title: PwmDurationPair holds independent period/active_duration fields and defaults to a zeroed pair
requirements.text: PwmDurationPair's period and active_duration fields are independently settable u32 values, and PwmDurationPair::default() yields period == 0 and active_duration == 0

requirements.title: AdcResolutionBits::new rejects zero and any bit width above 16, and never panics
requirements.text: AdcResolutionBits::new returns Err(RcpError::InvalidParameter) for 0 and for any value above 16, and never panics for any sampled u8 input

requirements.title: PwmOutFunctionalConfig defaults to a zeroed target PwmDurationPair
requirements.text: PwmOutFunctionalConfig::default().target equals PwmDurationPair::default()

requirements.title: AdcResolutionBits::max_raw_value computes 2^bits - 1, and default() resolves to 16 bits
requirements.text: AdcResolutionBits::max_raw_value returns 2^bits - 1 for every valid bit width including the u16::MAX boundary at 16 bits, and AdcResolutionBits::default resolves to the widest modeled resolution, 16 bits, as this crate's own unconfirmed-default placeholder

requirements.title: PwmOutFunctionalConfig::layer_tag matches EndpointType::PwmOut and rejects EndpointType::PwmIn
requirements.text: PwmOutFunctionalConfig::layer_tag returns a PerEpTypeFunctionalConfig tagged EndpointType::PwmOut that satisfies regmap::functional_config_matches_ep_type/check_functional_config_matches_ep_type against a PerEpConfigBlock also tagged EndpointType::PwmOut, and does not satisfy it against a PerEpConfigBlock tagged EndpointType::PwmIn

requirements.title: AdcSampleValue round-trips through encode/decode within its resolution and rejects raw values wider than that resolution, and never panics
requirements.text: AdcSampleValue::new/AdcSampleValue::decode/AdcSampleValue::encode round-trip any raw value within AdcResolutionBits::max_raw_value as a 2-byte big-endian wire form, reject any raw value exceeding that maximum with RcpError::InvalidParameter, and decode never panics for any sampled input

requirements.title: PwmInFunctionalConfig defaults to a zero no_signal_timeout
requirements.text: PwmInFunctionalConfig::default().no_signal_timeout equals 0

requirements.title: AdcFunctionalConfig defaults to the default AdcResolutionBits and a zeroed AdcAveragingConfig
requirements.text: AdcFunctionalConfig::default carries AdcResolutionBits::default (16 bits) and a zero-valued AdcAveragingConfig (adc_sample_interval, adc_avg_intervals_per_request, and adc_combine_avg_values all zero)

requirements.title: PwmInFunctionalConfig::layer_tag matches EndpointType::PwmIn and rejects EndpointType::PwmOut
requirements.text: PwmInFunctionalConfig::layer_tag returns a PerEpTypeFunctionalConfig tagged EndpointType::PwmIn that satisfies regmap::functional_config_matches_ep_type/check_functional_config_matches_ep_type against a PerEpConfigBlock also tagged EndpointType::PwmIn, and does not satisfy it against a PerEpConfigBlock tagged EndpointType::PwmOut

requirements.title: AdcFunctionalConfig's layer tag matches crate::regmap's EndpointType::Adc cross-layer rule
requirements.text: AdcFunctionalConfig::layer_tag produces a crate::regmap::PerEpTypeFunctionalConfig tagged EndpointType::Adc that satisfies crate::regmap::check_functional_config_matches_ep_type against a generic PerEpConfigBlock of the same ep_type, and is rejected by functional_config_matches_ep_type against a mismatched ep_type

requirements.title: resolve_pwm_in_read reports Measured(pair) whenever elapsed_since_last_edge is below no_signal_timeout and a measurement exists
requirements.text: resolve_pwm_in_read returns Some(PwmInReadResolution::Measured(pair)) whenever last_measured is Some(pair) and elapsed_since_last_edge is strictly less than config.no_signal_timeout

requirements.title: resolve_adc_sample_window_ticks chains adc_sample_interval, adc_avg_intervals_per_request, and adc_combine_avg_values into a total elapsed tick count, and never panics
requirements.text: resolve_adc_sample_window_ticks multiplies adc_avg_intervals_per_request by adc_combine_avg_values by adc_sample_interval to produce the total elapsed tick count one combined result takes to produce, using checked (never-wrapping, never-panicking) arithmetic throughout including at the all-MAX field-width boundary, and never panics for any sampled AdcAveragingConfig

requirements.title: resolve_pwm_in_read reports NoSignal once the timeout elapses, never re-reporting a stale prior measurement
requirements.text: resolve_pwm_in_read returns Some(PwmInReadResolution::NoSignal) whenever elapsed_since_last_edge is greater than or equal to config.no_signal_timeout, regardless of whether last_measured carries a prior value, and a zero-valued no_signal_timeout is not treated as a disabled sentinel

requirements.title: resolve_adc_averaged_value computes the two-level averaging pipeline over raw samples
requirements.text: resolve_adc_averaged_value groups raw_samples into adc_avg_intervals_per_request-sized groups, averages each group (level one), then averages the first adc_combine_avg_values group averages into the returned combined result (level two), ignoring any trailing raw samples beyond what the pipeline consumes

requirements.title: resolve_pwm_in_read returns None while genuinely awaiting a first edge before the timeout elapses, rather than hanging
requirements.text: resolve_pwm_in_read returns None when last_measured is None and elapsed_since_last_edge is strictly less than config.no_signal_timeout, letting a polling caller retry instead of this function blocking

requirements.title: resolve_adc_averaged_value rejects a malformed averaging pipeline configuration, and never panics
requirements.text: resolve_adc_averaged_value returns Err(RcpError::InvalidParameter) when adc_avg_intervals_per_request or adc_combine_avg_values is zero, when raw_samples carries fewer raw samples than the pipeline requires (including at the u16::MAX/u16::MAX field-width boundary), or defensively if their product would overflow usize, and never panics for any sampled AdcAveragingConfig/raw_samples combination

requirements.title: validate_adc_sample_request accepts AdcSamplingMode::RequestDriven and rejects AdcSamplingMode::Continuous with RcpError::UnsupportedCmd
requirements.text: validate_adc_sample_request returns Ok(()) for AdcSamplingMode::RequestDriven (also AdcSamplingMode's default) and Err(RcpError::UnsupportedCmd) for AdcSamplingMode::Continuous, enforcing the roadmap's request-driven-sampling-only rule since no free-running/continuous sampling mode is permitted

requirements.title: resolve_pwm_in_read never panics for any sampled combination of config, last_measured, and elapsed inputs
requirements.text: resolve_pwm_in_read does not panic across sampled boundary combinations of no_signal_timeout (including 0 and u32::MAX), last_measured (None, a zeroed pair, and a maximal pair), and elapsed_since_last_edge (including 0 and u32::MAX)
